records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Systems
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Summit Systems* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Account created first project day 0 and sent 1 invite, showing some momentum, but no key milestone in 6 days and no inbound replies to the welcome email [email:e681ac28]; no tickets. 8 days left; partial setup without follow-through suggests modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: A quick next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Nice work getting your first project set up and an invite out to a teammate. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next natural step is getting real work into that project alongside your teammate.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through how your team is likely to use projects and tasks day to day, and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Priya
